App.Title: PF2E Item Forge
App.Heading: Item Forge
App.Subtitle: One item, many knobs to turn.

Hints.EmptyRarityMeansAll: No selection means all rarities are allowed.
Hints.SolverAttempts: Already part of the stable request schema; the treasure generator will use this value in a later phase.
Hints.EquipmentMode: Selects a non-specific base item from the chosen compendiums and applies a level-appropriate combination of fundamental runes.
Hints.PropertyRunesLater: Property runes will be added as a separate component block; this version already establishes level resolution and property-rune capacity.
Hints.PropertyRuneMode: Automatic fills available rune slots with level-appropriate runes; Random varies count and selection; Fixed uses only the selected runes.
Hints.NoPropertyRunes: No property runes are registered for this item type.
Hints.PropertyRuneCapacity: The actual number of property runes is limited by the potency rune value.
Hints.ScrollSources: For scrolls, spell compendiums are also offered as sources. The generic scroll is only a template; the generated item receives a suitable spell.

Preview.Empty: Nothing forged yet. Choose parameters and press Generate.

Notifications.GenerationFailed: No item could be generated for these parameters.
Notifications.ItemCreated: {name} was created in the Item Directory.

DefaultSolverAttempts.Name: Item Forge: default ValueSolver attempts
DefaultSolverAttempts.Hint: Default maximum attempts for value-based generators. Individual API requests may override it up to the safety maximum.

DefaultSourceMode.Name: Item Forge: default source mode
DefaultSourceMode.Hint: Which item compendiums new requests use by default.

GenerationMode.Equipment: Compose a weapon, armor, or shield

Errors.NoBaseEquipment: No suitable non-specific base item was found in the selected compendiums.
Errors.UnsupportedEquipmentCategory: The “compose equipment” generation type supports only weapons, armor, and shields.
Errors.NoItemInLevelRange: No item matches the selected category and level constraint.
Errors.ItemDocumentNotFound: The selected item could not be loaded from its compendium.
Errors.InvalidPropertyRuneSelection: The selected property runes are incompatible with the base item, exceed available rune slots, or fall outside the allowed level/rarity constraints.
Errors.NoScrollSpellCandidate: No spell suitable for a scroll was found in the selected sources. Cantrips, focus spells, and rituals are excluded.
Errors.SpellDocumentNotFound: The selected spell could not be loaded from its compendium.
